metadata.description: 6-Max Cash, 100bb. BTN opens to 2.5bb, Hero is in the SB with the BB still to act. 3-bet to 11bb, call 2bb more, or fold.

source.detail: Hand-authored from standard 6-max 100bb preflop theory. NOT solver output - these are reasonable reference ranges, not an equilibrium. Replace with solver exports when available.

spec.RAISE: 88+, ATs+, AJo+, KQs, KJs, KTs, QJs, QTs, JTs, KQo, A9s-A2s, K9s, Q9s, J9s, T9s, 98s, 87s, 76s, 65s
spec.DEFEND: 88+, ATs+, AJo+, KQs, KJs, KTs, QJs, QTs, JTs, KQo, A9s-A2s, K9s, Q9s, J9s, T9s, 98s, 87s, 76s, 65s, 77-22, K8s-K2s, Q8s-Q6s, J8s, J7s, T8s, T7s, 97s, 86s, 54s, ATo, KJo, KTo, QJo, JTo

explanations.RAISE: The Button's 45% opening range is the widest we face, so this is the widest 3-betting range we have. Out of position with the BB behind, taking the pot down now or playing with the initiative is worth far more than flatting.
explanations.CALL: A small set of hands that flop well enough to defend without 3-betting. Everything else that continues should raise.
explanations.FOLD: Wide as the Button's range is, calling out of position with the Big Blind still to act needs a real hand. Fold the rest rather than flat them.
